spec.query: SELECT sum("Bytes")  / 7500000 FROM "autogen"."vbr_flow" WHERE ("direction"::tag = 'out') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "AttachmentId"::tag

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
    SUM(f.rejected_count) AS Total_TCP_OUT
FROM bline_flow_summary_ap_northeast_1_new f
LEFT JOIN ec2_instances src ON strpos(src.private_ips, f.srcaddr) > 0
LEFT JOIN ec2_instances dst ON strpos(dst.private_ips, f.dstaddr) > 0
WHERE f.flowdirection = 'egress' 
  AND f.protocol = '6'
  AND $__timeFilter(f.start_ts);
